name: Sayonara Jinsei.
source:
Toshiko, a high school girl, sits alone in an abandoned classroom.
Frustrated with life, she walks to the rooftop to end it all—
but then she hears a voice.
Something invisible... something not quite human.
And so begins a strange and mysterious story. 

[From [url=https://mizunotoami.itch.io/sayonara-jinsei-goodbye-life]itch.io[/url]]
